resources.string: Messages, calls, sounds and local connection
These preferences apply only to this device. Messages and call history keep arriving when alerts are off.
Pause alerts without stopping message delivery. Your choices below are kept.
Notifications outside UNYRI. Muted chats stay muted.
Ringtone and system incoming-call notification. An incoming call remains visible inside UNYRI.
Turn off for silent message notifications. Ringtone and vibration are managed separately in Android.
Show a new message banner while another screen is open.
Android controls permission, lock-screen display, ringtone and vibration. Administrative and service notifications are also managed here. UNYRI cannot override your system choices.

A reachable UNYRI server on the same local network can deliver messages without internet. Enable the local connection below to keep Android connected in the background. Its ongoing connection indicator remains visible. Force-stop, battery restrictions or a Wi-Fi interruption can stop delivery.
